title: Method for improving performance of federal learning in Non-IID and Mismatched scenes
assignee: University of Science and Technology of China USTC

pse.problem: Performance degradation in federal learning when data is Non-IID or Mismatched due to utilization of only model parameters without consideration of other parameters in the conventional method.
pse.solution_function: Improve the performance of federal learning under Non-IID and Mismatched scenes by using a local generation countermeasure network in each client, predicting false data, selecting the false data subset, uploading it to the server for processing, and training the intermediate state model with the obtained pseudo data set with approximate IID distribution.
pse.solution_structure: A network system consisting of at least one server side communicating with a plurality of clients, each client having a local model and a pre-trained local generation countermeasure network.
pse.solution_implementation: Each client updates its local model in each round of training. The server side aggregates the local models of the clients into an intermediate model, transmits it back to the clients. After receiving the intermediate state model, each client uses it for predicting false data, selects the false data subset, and uploads it to the server. The server processes the pseudo data subsets received from the clients to obtain a pseudo data set with approximate IID distribution, which is used for training the intermediate state model.
pse.effect: Enhanced performance of federal learning under Non-IID and Mismatched scenes by utilizing both model parameters and other parameters in the method, resulting in improved efficiency and potential reduction in resource usage.
